newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Coat has 3 of 5 claims dismissed.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Coat has 3 of 5 claims dismissed.

text.p: Burlington Coat Factory Warehouse Corp said the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit in Philadelphia upheld a lower dismissal of a class action suit against the firm, stemming from a drop in its stock price in 1994.
The company said that the court affirmed the dismissal of three claims in their entirety.

However, Burlington said the appellate court allowed the plaintiffs to attempt to replead two of the five claims, concerning alleged overstatement of 1994 earnings, and an officer's affirmation of an analyst's estimate, if the plaintiffs believe they can satisfy the relevant pleading standards.
